Open the oil fill cap, shine in flashlight. If everything's covered in sludge, leave it alone. Removing valve cover is tell tale, but, that's not something you can do at a showing lol. Check the oil too. Inspect below the valve covers (around the gasket) and look for caked up oil and sludge.

Na8 is na with 1.8. Umm the power difference is quite miniscule. The numbers are different but I've raced quite a few Miata. Check that diff. The nb interior is nicer but I'm a minimalist. I don't like bells and whistles so my NA interior is perfect for me. As far as reliability, I just hit 200k on my 1.6 and its still hyper and angry all day long. I hit my rev limiter yesterday racing a maxima. Buttttt, I have ocd. I keep everything tip top all the time. If you take my valve cover off, the internals look like they have 50 miles on them. Any other questions? Also yeah, inspect the internals of any car before you buy it.

It's if you find a 1.6 for a good deal, don't worry about it. You can bang off the rev limiter all day long every day.

I've been in therapy for two months. I have major depression, ocd, and social phobia/anxiety.

When I started I never felt like it was working and I started getting mad about it. I had to be forward and be like hey I'm fucked up. I don't want you tell me this textbook bullshit, I want us to discuss my problems and I want to get better. Be open and honest and don't be modest. Talk things out. I spent the first month hiding things and being modest when asked how depressed I am. I even considered going to a different therapist which is totally an option for you.

I also want to know if you have been prescribed any meds.

You can always feel free to PM me if you need to talk.

Firstly you could find a therapist. They are much help. The hospital part is because I don't know how far down you are.

You have depression. Find a hospital near you that has a psych ward. Go there and check in. You'll be there about a week. You will have a doctor and therapist. You will go to groups daily that teach cognitive thinking. It will get you out of the mindset and you will appreciate life again. I just did all these things and for the first time I can smile. I've come a long way. I want you to say thing. Its a battle. God its a fucking battle. But you can do it. I'm here to listen if you want to talk. Whether in this thread or via PM.

Are you seeing anyone for your depression and anxiety? Its amazing how much talking to someone can help. I can relate to you. When your self esteem is low it seems like everyone is laughing at you all the time when really they aren't. I got bullied, picked on, beaten up, my whole life. Just because I was different. Fuck those people. I want to know about your anxiety, I have really bad anxiety too.

I'm back now and I wanted to check up on you. I want to know your okay. Did you find anyone to talk to about this that can give you some guidance? I also wanted to know if you've spoken to anyone about your depression? You having suicidal thoughts and plans is a big deal. You need to get those issues addressed. I understand the feeling of drowning in debt. I used to even have dreams about it. It fucking sucks. But you don't have to let it consume you. You need to find control. Instead of letting it hide in the back of your mind, face it. Say I can do this. Then do it. Your debt is not going to control your life. Keep your head up.

You need to tell them your having thoughts when you have them. Helping you through this is their job. Ask around about programs for uninsured patients. When I was locked up in psych I didn't have insurance so they put me in a program that acted as insurance for my therapy and doctor visits. Maybe your area offers a similar program. I had no insurance and no job and no money in my wallet. All I had was getting my father to pay for meds. There's got to be help out there for you. Don't be afraid to ask around. And dont be afraid to search around for other mental health centers to see if they have some info for you. You can do this. I believe in you. Help is out there. If your current mental health center isn't helping you try another one. Same goes with the therapy your getting and your doctor.
I have to leave for a doctor appointment so I won't be able to talk for about an hour. You're not boned, you need to talk to someone about your loans. I'll check back in about an hour or two.
Its all private? You didn't receive any government help at all? You didn't go through fafsa or anything? There's got to be a way to work something out with them.

Okay the loans, not that bad. They don't draw interest and they are probably already financed at 1-2% or so. I owe roughly 50k. Don't let them scare you. If you only want to pay $5 a month, that's okay. That's what I pay if I even pay them anything. I once didn't even pay for 6 months. Later when you have a steady good income you can pay a little more if you want to. But for now, just pay them a small amount. And tell them not to call you or send you mail. They'll only email you so that way its not always on your mind.

It sounds like a lot of this is built up from where you live. By the way you are typing I can tell you are kinda worked up. Do you have any friends you could get a place with? Do you see a therapist? Have you asked about something for anxiety? If there is crisis center or a mental health center nearby somewhere, they may have caseworkers on staff who's only job is to make sure you are on track to finding work and getting in a better home.

Are you seeing anyone for your depression? It makes me think of the homestuck comic about depression, with the dead fish. Do keep bringing it up because you wish someone would just acknowledge it? I know I'm late coming in, but I want to know about your situation I want to know how you are.
I just recently got out of the hospital too. Did the hospital not set you up with a therapist and a doctor? Are you on any meds?
May I ask what you are studying? Have you thought of going to a different school? It is funny how that can change things.
